trigger: v1 identity-specific vertical-state prediction was positive; v2 prospectively tests whether that identity signal remains after absorbing each individual's marginal altitude preference.

models.individual_marginal: P_i(z) shrunk toward P_species(z) by lambda equivalent events.
models.marginal_adjusted_cell_baseline: For individual i, P_i_add(z|cell) proportional to P_species(z|cell) * P_i(z)/P_species(z). This carries individual marginal altitude preference but no individual-by-cell interaction.
models.individual_spatial_model: P_i_full(z|cell) = (raw early individual-cell z counts + lambda * P_i_add(z|cell)) / (n_i_cell + lambda). With no early events in a cell it equals P_i_add exactly.

primary_test.pairwise_gain: For source individual i and target late individual j, mean log P_i_full(z|cell) - log P_i_add(z|cell).
primary_test.observed: mean diagonal gain across 8 identity-matched source-target pairs
primary_test.null: all 8! permutations of source individual identity assigned to late target individuals
primary_test.one_sided_p: fraction of all permutations with assigned mean gain >= observed diagonal mean
primary_test.support_rule: p <= 0.05 and at least 6 of 8 diagonal residual gains > 0
primary_test.interpretation_if_pass: stable individual-by-location vertical organization remains after marginal altitude preference is controlled
primary_test.interpretation_if_fail: v1 identity signal is not sufficient to establish location-specific strategy beyond marginal altitude preference

prohibited: post-hoc change to lambda, cells, bins, or temporal split after v2 output
